entry.name: jit.gl.multiple
entry.description: Uses several jit.matrix objects to repeatedly draw an instance of a jit.gl object like jit.gl.mesh or jit.gl.gridshape. It attaches to a named instance of a jit.gl (OB3D) object provided by the targetname attribute.

messages.name: color_matrix
messages.description: Specifies a named matrix to use for the color parameter if it's in the glparams list. Must be a 4-plane float32 matrix in RGBA format.

messages.name: position_matrix
messages.description: Specifies a named matrix to use for the position parameter if it's in the glparams list. Must be a 3-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: rotate_matrix
messages.description: Specifies a named matrix to use for the rotate (angle-axis) parameter if it's in the glparams list. Must be a 4-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: rotatexyz_matrix
messages.description: Specifies a named matrix to use for the rotatexyz parameter if it's in the glparams list. Must be a 3-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: scale_matrix
messages.description: Specifies a named matrix to use for the scale parameter if it's in the glparams list. Must be a 3-plane float32 matrix.

messages.name: texture_matrix
messages.description: Specifies a named matrix to use for the texture parameter if it's in the glparams list. Must be a char matrix.
